question: Can the remaining reusable world-scale systems be extracted from The Game without importing gameplay concepts or weakening the existing Scene boundary?
hypothesis: World residency/checkpoint/replication/atmosphere/audio/collider primitives can be expressed as small transport- and game-independent modules while Scene remains the local physical authority.

conditions.guard: no NPC, economy, airport, quest, city-generator or browser UI dependencies

acceptance.architecture: new modules import only game-engine primitives and standard platform APIs
acceptance.determinism: location, scheduling, replication and input ordering have fixed tests
acceptance.physics: atmosphere/aerodynamics/tyre primitives are driven by physical inputs rather than vehicle types
acceptance.honesty: generic collider schema is not presented as implemented narrow-phase support
